title: Linear Pluggable Optics (LPO)
summary: Linear pluggable optics that remove DSPs from optical modules to cut power in high-speed links.
bodyHtml:
What This Is

Removing DSPs from optical modules to reduce power consumption in 1.6T+ links..

Fundamental research phase — concept established, practical implementation remains unsolved. Our research database tracks 2 independent sources on this technology.

businessMeaning: Lower power per bit matters at 1.6T and beyond; the trade-off is link margin and interoperability risk.
investmentLens: Module makers and laser suppliers benefit; DSP vendors face disintermediation in short-reach links.
